title: Great Eastern GE-8958 Sonic The Hedgehog Plush - Super Sonic, 12"

reviews.title: رائع
reviews.date: Reviewed in Saudi Arabia on 4 August 2024

reviews.title: Great gift for any Sonic fan.
reviews.body: This Sonic plush was a birthday gift for my son, and he absolutely loves it. It’s soft, well-made, and the perfect size for cuddling and carrying around. Definitely a hit he hasn’t put it down since he opened it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on 25 June 2026
reviews.author: Jayla

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.body: It’s a scam. Instead of getting a Great Eastern liscenced plush you get a cheap knock-off. With the amount of money I payed as well? Disgusting
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 13 August 2025
reviews.author: Jamie

reviews.title: Excelente en calidad y precio. Lo recomiendo
reviews.body: Este Sonic esta hermoso mi nieto quedo feliz con su regalo. Todos los días duerme con el.Es de excelente calidad y a buen precioMe llego a tiempo !!!Y en perfectas condiciones

reviews.title: 孫が大喜び
reviews.body: ゲームのキャラクターのようで、5歳の孫が大喜びしています。結構強く握って遊んでいますが丈夫で満足しています。
